## Vegetarian Meal Plan: October 7-13

This 7-day vegetarian meal plan provides varied, healthy meals for a single adult, targeting 1800-2000 calories daily. Each meal is designed for approximately 30 minutes of active cooking time.

## Plan Context
- Calorie estimates are approximate and can vary based on specific ingredients and portion sizes.
- "Active cooking time" refers to hands-on prep and cooking, not passive simmering or baking.
- Recipes assume basic pantry staples are available.

## Quick & Healthy Vegetarian Meals

### Day 1: Monday, October 7
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: **Berry Nut Oatmeal** - Rolled oats cooked with water/milk, topped with mixed berries, a handful of walnuts, and a drizzle of maple syrup.
- Afternoon: **Chickpea Salad Sandwich** - Mashed chickpeas mixed with celery, vegan mayo, and herbs, served on whole-wheat bread with lettuce and tomato.
- Dinner: **Quick Lentil Pasta** - Whole-wheat pasta with a store-bought marinara sauce, sautéed spinach, and a sprinkle of nutritional yeast.

### Day 2: Tuesday, October 8
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: **Yogurt & Granola Parfait** - Layers of Greek yogurt, granola, and fresh fruit (e.g., banana, apple slices).
- Afternoon: **Leftover Lentil Pasta** - Reheat and enjoy the previous night's pasta.
- Dinner: **Black Bean Burgers** - Store-bought black bean patties cooked and served on whole-wheat buns with lettuce, tomato, and a side salad.

### Day 3: Wednesday, October 9
- Morning: **Tofu Scramble with Toast** - Crumbled tofu sautéed with turmeric, nutritional yeast, and veggies (bell peppers, onions), served with whole-wheat toast.
- Afternoon: **Quinoa & Feta Salad** - Cooked quinoa mixed with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, Kalamata olives, feta cheese, and a lemon-herb vinaigrette.
- Dinner: **Speedy Veggie Stir-fry** - Quick-cooking vegetables (broccoli, carrots, snap peas) stir-fried with tofu or tempeh and a pre-made stir-fry sauce, served over brown rice.

### Day 4: Thursday, October 10
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: **Green Smoothie** - Blend spinach, banana, plant-based milk, a scoop of protein powder, and a tablespoon of almond butter.
- Afternoon: **Leftover Veggie Stir-fry** - Reheat and enjoy the previous night's stir-fry.
- Dinner: **Sheet Pan Fajita Veggies** - Bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms tossed with fajita seasoning and roasted until tender, served with warm tortillas and refried beans.

### Day 5: Friday, October 11
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: **Avocado Toast** - Smashed avocado on whole-wheat toast, seasoned with everything bagel seasoning or red pepper flakes.
- Afternoon: **White Bean & Kale Soup** - Canned cannellini beans, vegetable broth, sautéed kale, and diced tomatoes, simmered briefly.
- Dinner: **Quick Coconut Curry** - Canned full-fat coconut milk simmered with curry paste, chickpeas, and quick-cooking vegetables (e.g., frozen mixed veggies, spinach), served with basmati rice.

### Day 6: Saturday, October 12
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: **Vegan Pancakes** - Prepare a quick batch of vegan pancakes from a mix or scratch, topped with fresh fruit and maple syrup.
- Afternoon: **Leftover Coconut Curry** - Enjoy the flavorful curry from the previous evening.
- Dinner: **Mediterranean Couscous Bowls** - Fluffy couscous topped with hummus, chopped cucumber, tomatoes, Kalamata olives, a sprinkle of fresh parsley, and grilled halloumi or chickpeas.

### Day 7: Sunday, October 13
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: **Breakfast Burrito** - Scrambled eggs (or tofu scramble), black beans, salsa, and shredded cheese (or vegan cheese) wrapped in a whole-wheat tortilla.
- Afternoon: **Large Garden Salad** - Mixed greens with a variety of chopped vegetables, sunflower seeds, and a protein source like grilled tempeh or a hard-boiled egg.
- Dinner: **Hearty Vegetarian Chili** - Canned kidney beans, black beans, diced tomatoes, corn, and chili spices simmered for 20-30 minutes, served with a dollop of Greek yogurt or avocado.
